messages.text:

messages.subject: Re: Sleeping bags
messages.text:
Hello Keith!
 

 Thank you for reaching out with your suggestion about making vegan, environmentally-friendly sleeping bags. It’s a great idea, and we appreciate your input as we're always looking to expand our product line in sustainable ways. We'll certainly consider this as we plan our future products.
 

 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
